QuestInfo.name: Stolen Seal Stone
QuestInfo.0: Olive lied to you! Now what are you going to do? \r\nTalk to Athena Pierce.
QuestInfo.1: Olive lied to you! Now what are you going to do? \r\nTalk to Athena Pierce.
QuestInfo.2: The stolen jewel is actually a Seal Stone, a rock of immense powers. \r\nAthena Pierce says she'll be in touch when she finds out who took the jewel.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 35,000
Can proceed to Capturing the Thief or Athena Pierce's Summons

0.0: Ahhh, so that's what happened. It appears this Olive of yours stole the jewel. We must find her at once.
0.1: The jewel she stole is actually a Seal Stone made by the heroes who fought the Black Mage centuries ago...
0.2: It's a safety device, created to protect us so we could rebuild our ruined homes. Over time, people forgot the stones existed. But with the Heroes' recent revival, more and more people are seeking these stones.
0.3: Something tells me they're not using the Seal Stones to rebuild their ruined homes... No, I'm afraid there are many other uses for the Seal Stones, some of them very dark.
0.4: We need to learn more about Olive and the others she's working with. Will you help, #h0#?

no.0: Not many people know about the Seal Stones. I was hoping I could rely on you.

yes.0: It's vital we find out who they are and what their purpose is. I will contact you when I have a lead.
